MANAGEMENT

KEY RESEARCH PERSONNEL

DR. STEPHEN L. MATSON

Dr. Matson is the Vice President of Research and Development for Sepracor. During his nine years at General Electric's corporate Research and Development Laboratories, Dr. Matson specialized in the application of polymeric and liquid membranes to industrial gas and liquid separations, and he participated in the development of polymer processing and biochemical engineering technology. Most recently, Dr. Matson served for two years as Director of Research for Bend Research, Inc., where he had general management responsibility for both contract and internal research and developmental activities in this membrane-focussed contract and R&D organization. With Professor John Quinn, Dr. Matson is the co-inventor of the Company's membrane bioreactor technology. He holds a Ph.D. degree in one capital and Biochemical Engineering from the University of Pennsylvania and B.S. and M.S. degrees in Chemical Engineering from Cornell University. He is a Registered Professional Engineer (New York) and he currently serves as Editorial Board Member for the Journal of Membrane Science.

DR. ROBERT L. BRATZLER

Dr. Bratzler is Vice President of Commercial Development. Dr. Bratzler has most recently held a senior position in Research & Development with the Polaroid Corporation. Prior to joining Polaroid, Dr. Bratzler was an Assistant Professor of Chemical Engineering at Princeton University. Dr. Bratzler received his B.S. in Engineering from University of Michigan and his Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering from MIT. Dr. Bratzler is known for his early work in the modeling of membrane devices for hybrid artificial organs, his studies of blood protein interaction with synthetic membranes, and his work in the field of continuous affinity chromatography.
